desc: Obsidian is a full-auto rated modular suppressor constructed of durable 17-4 stainless steel and lightweight aluminum. Weighing 12.7 ounces in its long configuration, and 8.7 in its short configuration, the Obsidian boasts versatility and maneuverability. Offering impeccable sound reduction, Rugged’s Obsidian can be 7.8 inches, or shortened to 4.8 inches.
